objective: Tasks C, D, and E: Backend Foundation, Flutter Integration, and Firebase Migration for NGO Management System
acceptance_criteria: AC1: Fastify TypeScript backend with configuration, health and readiness endpoints
AC2: PostgreSQL pg connection pool integration
AC3: node-pg-migrate migration infrastructure with domain schema
AC4: Root-level Docker Compose with PostgreSQL 16 and private networking
AC5: Environment configuration and verified gitignore
AC8: Fastify domain endpoints covering patients, stays, rooms, attendance, payments, counters, settings, photos, and ERP with parameterized SQL, transactions, and pagination
AC9: Firebase token verification middleware and role authorization for Fastify backend
AC10: Flutter API client and service layer integrated with backend while preserving Drift/SQLite caching
AC11: Repeatable Firebase RTDB JSON export importer into PostgreSQL with validation, reconciliation, and foreign key integrity
AC12: Verification via automated backend tests, Flutter analysis, and importer test execution
